evidence: All Q1 Python modules passed py_compile.
Cleaned land, crop, planting, and economics tables loaded through the validated shared loader; raw files were not modified.
The main runner builds one 2024-2030 MILP and retains explicit activation, sales, surplus, rotation, bean-coverage, and greenhouse mode constraints.
Seed 2026, Python executable, platform, NumPy, pandas, and SciPy versions are recorded.
CSV/XLSX plans, validation JSON files, solver summaries, comparison table, and run_summary.json were written.
All six generated plans report zero independent hard-constraint violations.
Pure-profit incumbent gap is 4.41%; half-price incumbent gap is 0.82%; both Pareto minimum-waste stages had no incumbent and used the declared pure-profit feasible fallback.

findings.message: Q1(1) Pareto stages are feasible fallback plans, not newly solved minimum-waste optima; do not claim strict Pareto optimality.
